events.summary: (vendor/severity tags below are heuristic) Gitea's web attachment handler skips its cross-repository ownership check for attachments created before 16 January 2026 and checks permissions against the repository named in the request URL instead. This can expose issue and pull request attachments or release assets; the random attachment UUID must already be known to the attacker.
